title: Kinetic typography lab (source of the Kinetic Typography pack)
summary: The comps every Kinetic Typography template was built and verified in: word swap, impact stack, line reveal, beat words and focus pull.
use_when: You want to see a kinetic type pattern working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a job, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.

comps: KT Word swap (120 f, masked slot)
KT Focus pull (60 f, Stagger Text blur + tracking)

parameters: word swap words (regenerate windows with kinetic_type_lab.py)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Masks: the window is the mask (isMask) and the text its target; mask.make takes the FIRST id as the mask.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/kinetic_type_lab.py (two passes: measure, then build), then mask.make + parent.clear for each MASKS pair, edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
